title: Setting of Malachi
note: Whole picture is the map. Ezion Geber's dot is at the head of the gulf, so it uses Tell el-Kheleifeh (Wikidata) rather than the gazetteer's Jezirat Faraun island; Petra from Wikidata. Sela left out (identification disputed). The east half (Arabian desert) has no towns and is extrapolated.
